entries.what: Isabel walks to Flats High, sits through AP Calc and APUSH, and spends lunch with Nadia going over yearbook photos from the homecoming game.
entries.outcome: Photos sorted for the fall sports spread.

entries.what: After school she works at the library homework center on her personal statement and practice problems, then does dishes at home while Lola Cora's teleserye blares.
entries.outcome: Calc set done; essay left alone.

entries.what: Late at night she reads film scores on headphones and tweaks essay wording in bed until after 1 a.m.
Tuesday robotics in room C7 from 3:30 to 6, where Isabel runs the mechanical subteam and trades barbs with Lucas over the drivetrain.
entries.outcome: Gearbox mount fixed; Lucas still smug.

entries.what: Home for dinner, then at night she sends the assistant a list of essay edits to apply and asks for just the changes, nothing else. She likes that it comes back with a plain list.
entries.outcome: Essay edits listed; she signs off with thanks for skipping the pep talk.

entries.what: School day with AP Chem under Mr. Ostrowski and physics; she eats lunch with Nadia and complains about the week's workload.
entries.outcome: Got through the day without incident.

entries.what: Wednesday Mateo math: tutoring her Kessler Middle seventh-grader on ratios from 4 to 5, using pizza-slice drawings.
entries.outcome: Mateo finished all his problems and she earned her $20.

entries.what: Evening she puts $20 toward her application fee savings and does dishes before homework.
Thursday robotics in C7 again; she and Lucas argue over wiring layout, and she leaves at 6.
entries.outcome: Agreed on layout after a lot of eye-rolling.

entries.what: Late evening she asks the assistant to help build a spreadsheet for the egret count with tide times and spots from last year's tally notebook.
entries.outcome: Spreadsheet columns set up for tide times and trailhead spots.

entries.what: Halloween at school is a normal day with a few costumes; Isabel skips dressing up and shares candy with Nadia at lunch.
Evening she hands out candy at home while Lola Cora gives out full-size bars; later she takes a short walk past trick-or-treaters downtown with Nadia.
Harper's Saturday prep has wrapped, so Isabel sleeps in, then runs the Delgado Park loop before the day heats up.
Isabel asks Ramón, between his shifts, to back her case about the 9 p.m. weekend curfew; he talks to Grace and brokers a return to 10 p.m.
entries.outcome: Curfew goes back to 10 p.m. on weekends.

entries.what: Evening she goes out with Nadia in the beige sedan and is home by 10.
entries.outcome: Used the new curfew without incident.

entries.what: Sunday morning Isabel eats Lola Cora's sinigang prep at the kitchen counter while Grace is at Tagalog Mass and then grading.
entries.outcome: Pretended indifference, ate two bowls later.

entries.what: Afternoon at the desktop in Ramón's old setup she reviews the egret count spreadsheet and AP homework.
Night she drives with Ramón in the Ruel Road lots on his off day, practicing with her permit.
